result.reason: The operative language includes the preferred CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, workers’ compensation, and certificate requirements. However, requiring every policy to continue for one year after the term exceeds the playbook and is particularly awkward for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation, so the change is not minimal. The new clause is also poorly placed after the execution recital, and “Licensee data” should match the agreement’s defined Customer Data term. Unrelated counsel provisions remain unchanged.
